name: editor-maker-generator
title: 创建和导出完成的视频
description: Get edited video files ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something like "cut the pauses, add transitions, and export a clean final video", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for content creators and marketers who move fast and want to produce finished videos quickly without learning complex editing software.
title_en: Editor Maker Generator — Create and Export Finished Videos
